title: The car crash that killed Frank Teschemacher
summary: After a first job at Guyon's Paradise is booked, a cab hits Davison's open Packard at Magnolia and Wilson and Teschemacher dies that night.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Nothing to do with Texas Guyon-- and it was a ballroom out near the old Marlboro Theater--- out in that direction - on the west side and we were very happy about that. And, so, that's when we were all set to go in there and I had gone up to Tesh and I had gone up to see in the early evening - to see Jack Church; the guitar player---
Yeah - and he was playing with us too when he could---
He also played under the name of Jack Goss.

Yeah and we had been up to see him and, so, I had an open Packard at that time and, uh, I said to Tesh -- we'll drive you home, and so that was at Magnolia and Wilson--- that this happened and Magnolia going into Wilson was a stop street--- and we stopped there and looked both ways - saw nothing and I pulled out -- and what happened -- here comes a cab with no lights; we didn't see him and he hit us broadside--- and knocked us into a tree and I went through the drug store window and Tesh had his hands in his overcoat pocket and he went over the windshield and hit his head on the--- if he had his hands out of his pocket, he could have protected the fall--- and, uh, during that night, he died - he died during that night. And, of course, that kind of an accident, they picked me up and they took us both to the hospital and, uh, with that -- of course, it put me in jail until the accident was solved-- I got out the next day but---
